title: Queries on a Permutation With Key
summary: Process each query in the array by finding its position in the initial permutation P=[1,2,3,...,m], then move this element to the start of P, and record the position as the result for that query.
statement: Process each query in the array by finding its position in the initial permutation P=[1,2,3,...,m], then move this element to the start of P, and record the position as the result for that query.
constraints: For each query, record its zero-based position and move that value to the front.
hints: Find the queried value’s current zero-based index.
Remove it and insert it at position zero.
Performing these operations in order exactly mirrors the evolving permutation.
editorial: Performing these operations in order exactly mirrors the evolving permutation.

tests.explanation: The successive positions are 2, 1, 2, and 1 as queried values move forward.
Moving prior queries changes the later position of the repeated two.
